card.name: Words before play-themed toys and games
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, a, into, and, gets) in child play and toy passages, right where a pretend role, toy or playful object is about to be named.

modes.label: Toy or role choices
modes.description: A short word just before the toy or pretend role being offered to a child.
modes.example: equipment to play police officer (minus the gun)<< or>> fire fighter.

modes.label: Gifts and crafts
modes.description: The word 'a' or 'gets' before a gift or a made object for a child.
modes.example: Morris's sister Rose gets<< a>> beauty kit.

modes.label: Play spaces and kids' clubs
modes.description: Words in descriptions of imaginative play places or kid-focused groups.
modes.example: Driftwood and large rocks were made<< into>> secret hideaways.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words starting with "super", as in superhero or supermarket play themes.
